title: angelica litoralis
intro: Angelica litoralis, commonly known as sea angelica or sea angel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Angelica litoralis include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Angelica litoralis include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a sought-after ingredient in herbal remedies.
